title.narrative: Development of corporate social responsibility in the construction sector in China-Phase 2

description.narrative: After the successful operational implementation of the first phase from late 2013 until September 2017 with its main outputs 1. CSR Expertise, 2. CSR Advocacy and Promotion, 3. CSR Demonstrations, and 4. CSR Policy Advice the second phase of the project is aiming at upscaling and expanding its activities to a larger number of national CSR consultants, auditors, and construction enterprises. The main outputs of phase 2 comprise of: 1. Through strengthened CSR consultancy services, CSR implementation capacity of construction firms are enhanced, and 2. Voluntary CSR policies and their implementation for the construction sector strengthened, including with activities within the Belt and Road Initiative (BRI).
